verdict.rationale: Mercury offers narrow, domain-specific rules: categorization rules created via Command that apply as transactions arrive, multi-layered bill approval rules, and recurring invoices on a schedule. Categorization and reconciliation also run automatically. There is no evidence of a general-purpose event-to-action rule engine, and the API and MCP layer that would allow custom automations are only promised as coming 'soon'. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers on arbitrary events, configurable actions beyond categorization and approvals, a webhook or API-driven automation surface that is actually shipped, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
